progress_assessment: Approximate full-port estimate, up from 10%: the RoR 1.0a command layer, order-to-action routing, A* pathfinding, unit movement, the attack action, combat damage, projectiles and blasts are now translated, and units walk and fight on a real campaign map through that code. Still unfinished: unit death and most action classes (gather, build, trade, convert), the player/economy update loop, research effects, computer AI, UI/input and menus, audio playback, saves/multiplayer, and Vita integration and packaging. Not validated against original-game traces or on Vita hardware.
effort_assessment: Eight builders represent the high effort setting for this reporting period (sustained simulation translation work), not eight people or a measured number of work hours.
